in_marathi.name: Sahdev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahdev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sah means 'complete' and Dev means 'god'. This name is given to the deity who is believed to be the god of the earth and is considered to be the ruler of all the underworld. He is believed to be the god of agriculture, wealth, and prosperity. Sahdev is also known as Sahasralinga, which means 'thousand-hooded'
